_comment: The answers the webchat area streams to probe the sanitizer (spec 01 'One render path, no router', spec 07 'The sanitizer is a security boundary'). Each is checked as one token and split across two tokens, and in the diff picker on both sides. 'why' is what the payload is there to catch; tests/webchat/README.md lists them. A payload opening with an element the HTML parser would move to <head> (style, meta, base, template) is preceded by text, so it stays in the answer's body.

payloads.why: the plain <script> element: html:true lets raw HTML through markdown-it, so only the allowlist removes it
an element outside the allowlist carrying an inline handler; img is stripped (spec 01: 'img stays stripped')
on* attributes on ALLOWED elements (b, a, p): the element survives, the attribute must not
javascript: in an <a href>, plain and obfuscated: mixed case, leading whitespace, a tab entity inside the scheme, a decimal entity for the first letter
the other script-capable schemes: data: (spec 07 names it) and vbscript:
an <iframe> with a javascript: src and a srcdoc holding a script
the plugin elements, each able to load active content
a <style> element (could restyle the whole window) and a style attribute carrying a url(javascript:)
payloads.html: Text first, so the parser keeps it in the body: styled

payloads.why: SVG brings its own <script>, onload, an <a xlink:href>, and animation elements that can set an href to javascript:
MathML namespace confusion (the DOMPurify mXSS family): an that a re-parse could resurrect
parses differently with scripting on and off: the attribute text must not become an on the second parse
a <form> with a javascript: action and a <button formaction>
<meta http-equiv=refresh> to a javascript: URL, and a <base href> that would rebase every relative link
payloads.html: Text first, so the parser keeps it in the body: rel

payloads.why: a <template> whose content is a separate fragment a naive element walk never visits
payloads.html: Text first, so the parser keeps it in the body: visible

payloads.why: an event that fires with no user action (<details open ontoggle>)
markdown syntax rather than HTML: a javascript: link, a data: image and a javascript: autolink
markup inside a code fence must stay text (spec 01: 'Code fences still show markup as text')
